name: Answer support emails with an AI agent that uses the Notion and Linear MCP servers
description: An AI agent reads each new support email, triages it, searches your Notion help center over MCP, creates a Linear issue over MCP and replies to the customer. The agent follows plain English instructions, and every model call and tool call is recorded in the execution log.
shortDescription: Triage support emails, search a Notion help center, open a Linear issue and reply, with one AI agent and two MCP servers.
keyFeatures: One AI Agent step driven by plain English instructions instead of branches and mappings
Two MCP servers as tools: Notion for the help center and Linear for tickets
Triage into a fixed set of categories and priorities, written into the Linear issue
Replies that use only facts from help center articles, and fall back to the issue identifier
Every model call and MCP tool call recorded in the execution log
prerequisites: Google Mail (Gmail) connection for the support inbox
Linear personal API key and a team named Support
Notion internal integration with access to your help center pages
Notion MCP server reachable from ByteChef (for example @notionhq/notion-mcp-server started with --transport http)
idealFor: Support teams that want an AI agent to handle first-line email support, with every decision it makes visible and auditable.
steps: Trigger: poll Gmail for a new unread email.
The AI agent triages the email into a category and a priority.
The agent searches the Notion help center through the Notion MCP server and reads the best articles.
The agent creates a Linear issue through the Linear MCP server with the triage, the articles and the drafted reply.
The agent drafts a reply that uses only facts from the articles.
Reply to the customer in the same Gmail thread.
